title: The Greatest Of All Is Love
firstLine: Walking by faith and not by sight,

lines: Walking by faith and not by sight,
Serving the Lord by solemn right,
That the greatest of all is love!
Filled with a hope of heaven's grace,
Longing to see our Savior's face,
Yet the greatest of all is love!
Learning to love with all the heart,
Striving each day to do our part;
Loving our neighbors and our Lord,
For the greatest of all is love!
Love never fails, but ever avails;
Abiding is faith and hope and love -
But the greatest of all is love!
